data.name: v1.156.0
data.body:
## [v1.156.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.156.0)

Released at 2026-11-09

* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics [Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) components: run with the `-eula` command-line flag to accept [ESA](https://victoriametrics.com/legal/esa/). License keys are no longer verified. The `-license`, `-licenseFile`, `-licenseFile.reloadInterval` and `-license.forceOffline` flags are deprecated and are treated as `-eula`, so existing setups keep working. See [Running VictoriaMetrics Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#running-victoriametrics-enterprise).
* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add new metric `process_cgroup_cpu_throttled_seconds_total` which exposes CPU throttling. See [#10430](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10430).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): support `authentication_method: WorkloadIdentity` in [azure_sd_configs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#azure_sd_configs). It allows discovering Azure VMs from Kubernetes clusters with [workload identity federation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/workload-id/workload-identity-federation) without a static client secret. See [#11558](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11558). Thanks to @banlor for contribution.
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add a new flag `-remoteWrite.queuePath`, which allows configuring [persistent-queue](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#on-disk-persistence) path for each `-remoteWrite.url` independently. See [#11662](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11662).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add `vmagent_kafka_consumer_rebalance_events_total` and `vmagent_kafka_consumer_assigned_partitions` metrics for monitoring partition rebalancing and distribution. See [partition distribution](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/#partition-distribution) and [#11370](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11370).
* FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): add `-notifier.sanitizeLabelNames` command-line flag. Set it to `false` to send alert label names to notifiers without replacing characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_:]` with underscores. This is useful for Alertmanager v0.27.0 or newer, which [supports UTF-8 label names](https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#utf-8-strict-mode) when not running in classic mode. See [#11629](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11629).
* FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), `vmstorage` and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): expose the working-set cache mode via `vm_cache_mode` for `storage/tsid`, `storage/metricIDs`, `storage/metricName`, `indexdb/tagFiltersLoops`, and `promql/rollupResult` cache. Values are `0` for split, `1` for switching, and `2` for whole. This metric helps users understand the internal memory and cache mechanisms. See [#11860](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11860).

* BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: OS `solaris` fixes compilation error. See [#11850](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11850). Thanks to @szaydel for contribution.
* BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: correctly detect `CPU` and `memory` `cgroup` limits configured via [systemd slices](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.slice.html) in `cgroup v1`. Previously, only the global host cgroup limit was used, which could cause OOM errors and CPU throttling. See [#11827](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11827).
* BUGFIX: [alerts](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules): stop [vmbackupmanager alerting rules](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-vmbackupmanager.yml) `NoLatestBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoHourlyBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoDailyBackupWithinLast3Days`, `NoWeeklyBackupWithinLast14Days` and `NoMonthlyBackupWithinLast62Days` from firing when scheduled backups are disabled via `-disableScheduledBackups` or the corresponding backup type is disabled via `-disableHourly`, `-disableDaily`, `-disableWeekly` or `-disableMonthly`. See [#11543](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11543).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): properly delay flushes after a sudden ingestion lag spike when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled. Previously, a data gap or a restart could reduce the tolerance for delayed samples to the aggregation interval, resulting in more dropped samples than necessary. See [#11866](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11866).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent skipping aggregation and deduplication flushes when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled and incoming samples are delayed by one interval or more, e.g. when the ingestion pipeline is overloaded. Previously, the flush delay could grow with the sample lag, causing skipped flushes and gaps in the results. Now the flush delay is capped at 90% of the aggregation or deduplication interval. See [#11811](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11811).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent spikes in `rate_sum` and `rate_avg` outputs with `enable_windows: true` when out-of-order samples arrive around the aggregation window boundary. Previously, an out-of-order sample could be treated as a counter reset, causing large spike in the result. See [#11810](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11810).
* BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): send staleness markers for recording rule series with their original labels when a label value contains `,` or `=`, and avoid reporting distinct label sets as duplicates when these symbols occur in label values. Previously, staleness markers could be sent with broken labels and distinct label sets could collide in the series key. See [#11851](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11851). Thanks to @sarankumar1325 for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly calculate [running_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#running_avg) and [range_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#range_avg) for series with `NaN` points in the middle. Previously, every `NaN` point was counted in the divisor, so each value after the gap moved the result by less than it should. See [#11823](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11823). Thanks to @spicysharkco for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): do not increase `vm_http_request_errors_total` when a query is cancelled. This prevents false `RequestErrorsToAPI` alerts from firing. See [#11828](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11828).
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly parse `metricsql` expression numbers with leading zeroes, such as `09` or `08`. See [#11621](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11621). Thanks to @andriibeee for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly check `-search.maxPointsSubqueryPerTimeseries` limit for [subqueries](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#subqueries). Previously it could cause runtime panic. See [#11862](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11862).
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): correctly cancel query request if `-search.skipSlowReplicas` flag is set. See [#11771](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11771) for details.
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): fixes predefined dashboard rows not expanding when clicking the row title. See [#11829](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11829). Thanks to @nikshrma for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): support label names with special characters in series aliases. See [#11822](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11822). Thanks to @kema-dev for contribution.

data.name: v2.8.8
data.body:
This patch release fixes PhysicalMachineChaos configuration, workflow deletion, controller selection, and TimeChaos on ARM64. It also fixes Dashboard HTTP task parsing, skips terminated pods by default, and includes build updates.

### Breaking changes

> [!WARNING]
> - **Redis Sentinel `redisPath`.** The previous boolean type was incorrect. Chaosd expects a directory string for the `redis-server` executable. This release corrects the field type to a string. Remove existing boolean values or replace them with a directory string before upgrading. [#5204](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5204)
> - **PhysicalMachineChaos disk-fill.** Chaos Mesh uses `fill-by-fallocate`, while Chaosd uses `fallocate`. This release correctly maps the Chaos Mesh field to the Chaosd field. Chaosd defaults to `fallocate`, but Chaos Mesh uses `fallocate` only when `fill-by-fallocate` is explicitly set to `true`. Setting it to `false` or omitting it now uses `dd`. The field names and default behavior may be unified in a future release. [#5205](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5205)

### Changed

- Use Go build metadata for binary version information and preserve release versions for builds from release tags [#5198](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5198)
- Remove CGO dependency from chaos-daemon-helper (cdh) [#4801](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4801)

### Fixed

- Fix PhysicalMachineChaos disk-fill requests to honor `fill-by-fallocate`. Setting it to `true` uses `fallocate`. Setting it to `false` or omitting it now uses `dd` [#5205](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5205)
- Fix PhysicalMachineChaos Redis Sentinel `redisPath` to accept executable directories. Remove existing boolean values before upgrading [#5204](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5204)
- Fix missing Kafka authentication, fill configuration, and IO broker settings in PhysicalMachineChaos, and keep Kafka credentials out of controller logs [#5203](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5203)
- Fix the Chaos Dashboard HTTP task parser panicking on a header without a colon and accepting a command without a URL [#5200](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5200)
- Fix workflow deletion getting stuck when reconcilers recreate dependent resources while their owner is terminating [#5101](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5101)
- Fix selective controller enablement through `controllerManager.enabledControllers` for chaos experiments [#4980](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4980)
- Skip Succeeded and Failed pods when `podPhaseSelectors` is unset [#5150](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5150)
- Honor reconciliation cancellation in PhysicalMachineChaos requests to chaosd. [#5095](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5095)
- Fix TimeChaos crashes on ARM64 and preserve injection errors. [#5179](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5179)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/compare/v2.8.7...v2.8.8

data.name: v1.21.2
data.body:
# Improvements
Rook v1.21.2 is a patch release limited in scope and focusing on feature additions and bug fixes to the Ceph operator.

- operator: Disable msgr1 on osd, mgr, and mds when msgr2 is required (#18557, @trukhinyuri)
- osd: Filter RBD devices from LVM scans on host-based OSDs (#18413, @pujitha24)
- osd: Don't wipe metadata devices of existing OSDs (#18686, @lbarrosby)
- object: Log only the rgw zone fields rook reads (#18662, @jhoblitt)
- core: Redact secret flag values from reported commands (#18665, @jhoblitt)
- cephfsmirror: Stop embedding the peer bootstrap token in an error (#18661, @jhoblitt)
- nfs: Include cluster config overrides in client config (#18627, @taaahaaa)
- osd: Redact the lockbox secret from lvm zap output (#18670, @jhoblitt)
- security: Drop radosgw-admin output from object store errors (#18669, @jhoblitt)
- object: Redact credentials in CephBucketTopic endpoint logs (#18671, @jhoblitt)
- object: Add VAULT_TRANSIT_BACKEND_PATH for the RGW SSE-S3 transit mount (#18598, @A-RYAN-1)
- build: Bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 from 4.1.4 to 4.1.6 (#18677, @jhoblitt)
- kms: Migrate IBM Key Protect client to v1.0.1 (#18488, @travisn)
- test: Summarize most Secrets in collected logs instead of dumping them (#18668, @jhoblitt)
- object: Refuse OBC relink of a bucket owned by another user (#18660, @jhoblitt)
- operator: Retry CephCluster status update on conflict (#18639, @taraasrita10)

- [CHANGE] API: The experimental search endpoints now clamp `batch_size` to 1000. #19731
- [CHANGE] Configuration: Default --web.external-url to https when --web.config.file enables TLS. #19241
- [CHANGE] PromQL: Subquery samples are now included in the query TotalSamples and TotalSamplesPerStep statistics, and SamplesRead now counts reads from subqueries with an @ modifier in range queries. #19165
- [CHANGE] Remote write: Stop exposing the deprecated `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_failed_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_retried_total`, and `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_bytes_total` metrics for Remote Write 2.0 queues. #20080
- [CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in `prometheus_api_remote_write_without_metadata_appended_samples_total` even when `metadata-wal-records` is disabled. #19812
- [CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from `/api/v1/query_exemplars`. #19896
- [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the `X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps` HTTP header. #19066
- [FEATURE] Agent: Support metadata-wal-records in Prometheus Agent mode. #19684
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental `integral()` function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the `--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions` flag. #14440
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental query cost estimation, actual cost reporting, and configurable execution limits, enabled with `--enable-feature=query-cost`. #20028
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Smoothed and Anchored vector selectors are now stable and always-on. #19697
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Use start timestamps to detect counter resets when float timeseries are queried using extended range selector modifiers (`anchored`, `smoothed`). This feature is hidden behind `use-start-timestamps` feature flag. #18966
- [FEATURE] Promtool: print test filename during promtool tests #18271
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Allow unquoted Unicode letters and dots behind a feature flag #20162
- [ENHANCEMENT] Search API: Warn when participating remote-read storage does not support search. #19992
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Read: Add native histogram prometheus_remote_read_handler_gate_wait_duration_seconds to measure concurrency-gate wait duration, including requests canceled while waiting. #18355
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Write: Add experimental flag `convert_nhcb_to_classic` to convert NHCB to classic histograms for external systems that dont support NHCBs. #17205
- [ENHANCEMENT] promtool: Add `--allow-incompatible-block-duration` so users can specify any max-block-duration instead of being restricted to the default Prometheus block durations. #19363
- [PERF] Remote write: Cache repeated OTLP histogram metric names. #19717
- [PERF] OpenMetrics 2.0 parser: Reuse classic histogram and summary expansion buffers across scrapes. #19907
- [PERF] PromQL: Decode only histogram sum/count (not buckets) for timestamp(), start_timestamp() and absent(). #19738
- [PERF] PromQL: Only select the fixed window for subqueries with an `@` modifier. #19863
- [PERF] Remote write / TSDB: Deduplicate per-series metadata structs in memory with `unique.Handle`. #20040
- [PERF] Scrape: Avoid some copies of scrape response bodies. #19394
- [PERF] TSDB: Improve XOR2 compression and append performance by selecting value windows based on encoding cost. #19962
- [PERF] TSDB: Reduce memory used writing and reading checkpoint metadata records. #19712
- [PERF] Scrape: Convert classic histograms to NHCB directly in the OpenMetrics 2.0 parser without wrapping in `NHCBParser`. #19880
- [PERF] Scrape: Reduce OpenMetrics 2.0 parser allocations and CPU overhead by lazily constructing composite series and exemplar labels. #19895
- [BUGFIX] Remote read: Abort failed streaming responses without writing duplicate headers or appending plain-text errors to the protobuf stream #19749
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix loss of out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record that the out-of-order write-behind log still needs #19737
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix queries that seek within a head chunk returning samples committed after the query started #19854
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve mapped chunks when WAL replay merges multiple references for the same series, preventing missing out-of-order samples and duplicate in-order chunks after restart #19805
- [BUGFIX] Fix auto-reload logic to reload after reverting a failed configuration change #19838
- [BUGFIX] API: Do not match metric family metadata for doubled _total and _info suffixes in experimental search API. #19910
- [BUGFIX] API: Reject `timeout` and `lookback_delta` values that overflow int64 instead of turning them into a negative duration #19658
- [BUGFIX] API: Resolve metric family metadata for suffixed metric names in search results, in experimental search API. #19824
- [BUGFIX] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache cluster once instead of twice for clusters that are not replication group members. #19434
- [BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands #19754
- [BUGFIX] Discovery: Fix a panic in Azure service discovery when a VM tag has a null value. #19755
- [BUGFIX] Federation: fix corruption of float native histograms. #19679
- [BUGFIX] Fix ts_of_last_over_time for samples before the Unix epoch. #19828
- [BUGFIX] Histograms: Fix ConvertNHCBToClassic inflating classic bucket counts for integer native histograms whose spans have gaps. #19659
- [BUGFIX] Logging: Preserve rule and TSDB block values in JSON logs. #19572
- [BUGFIX] OTLP receiver: Drop exemplars with timestamps more than 10 minutes in the future instead of storing them and blocking subsequent exemplars for that series. #19812
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Count only out-of-order exemplars in `prometheus_api_otlp_out_of_order_exemplars_total`, not every rejected exemplar. #20030
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not drop exemplars that have a `trace_id` or `span_id` filtered attribute in addition to a trace or span ID. The trace context now takes precedence over the colliding attribute, as required by the OpenTelemetry specification. #20004
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not emit `le="+Inf"` twice when a histogram's explicit bounds end at `+Inf`, and warn about the bound. #19425
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Stop dropping exemplars that arrive out of timestamp order within a data point. #20029
- [BUGFIX] OpenMetrics 2.0: Attach histogram exemplars to matching classic `_bucket` series and preserve them when scraping both native and classic histograms. #20020
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Avoid intermediate overflow in `rad()` and `deg()` conversions. #19901
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Consistently ignore and drop `__type__` and `__unit__` labels in `without` aggregations, `absent()`, `info()`, and binary operator fill matching. #19986
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Do not panic when printing the partial AST returned alongside a parse error. #19797
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Drop __type__ and __unit__ in binary operations so they are transparent to users, similar to how __name__ is handled. #18680
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix `==`, `!=`, `changes()` and `count_values` on native histograms giving wrong results inside `histogram_count()`, `histogram_sum()` and `histogram_avg()`. #20024
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_fraction returning wrong results for native histograms with custom buckets when a bucket boundary is exactly 0. #19657
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_quantile and histogram_quantiles interpolating within the wrong bucket for native histograms whose sum is NaN. #19973
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix lexing of subqueries whose range is a duration keyword expression, e.g. `foo[range():1s]`. #19729
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix warning and error locations for duration expressions `min_of` and `max_of`. #19742
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Ignore NaN classic histogram bucket boundaries in `histogram_quantile`, `histogram_quantiles` and `histogram_fraction` and return correct value instead of NaN if there are normal buckets. #20057
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve infinite values at exact quantile ranks. #19899
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve original operand sides for experimental fill modifiers with group_right matching. #19939
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve subquery step expressions when printing queries after preprocessing. #19743
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Range vector functions no longer raise a spurious "vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset" error when series have different metric names but the same remaining labels, as long as their timestamps do not overlap within the evaluated range window #18631
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: do not count subquery materialized samples in total samples statistics #19873
- [BUGFIX] Remote write: Prevent future-dated exemplars from scaling shards down to the minimum. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Agent: Prevent future sent timestamps from advancing WAL truncation beyond the minimum retention window. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Rules: Restore firing alerts with for durations shorter than --rules.alert.for-grace-period after a restart. #19882
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: fix failing scrape when float histogram is emitted over protobuf with count, zero count and buckets all zero, for example a result of recording `rate(x[1m])` over constant histogram. #19682
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Return the lexically smallest label values when `limit` is set on `/api/v1/search/label_values`, instead of an arbitrary subset #19694
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix WAL watcher permanently skipping checkpoint series garbage collection when lagging behind head truncation. #20041
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Avoid panics when the requested time range has no participating storage. #19992
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a race in selected-series and stale-series compaction where a sample committed after the block was written but before the series was evicted from the head could be silently lost. The fix no longer depends on isolation being enabled. #19666
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a rare case where a sample could be lost during selected-series or stale-series compaction if an unrelated write to the same series ran cleanup that erased the evidence needed to protect it. #19672
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix spurious "unknown series references" warnings during WAL replay after a restart, when the only blocks on disk were produced by selected-series or stale-series compaction. #19734
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Increment `prometheus_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total` when WAL corruption is detected during checkpoint creation, so the metric reflects corruption found at compaction time rather than only after a restart-triggered repair. #19858
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve series identities needed to recover exemplars after compaction and restart. #19940
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Reject native histograms whose span offsets overflow the int32 bucket index instead of storing them with corrupted buckets. #20034
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: fix no passing metadata-wal-records to TSDB from main feature flag. #19678
- [BUGFIX] Templates: Preserve IPv6 addresses with dotted zone identifiers in `stripDomain`. #19908
- [BUGFIX] UI: Don't automatically open an autocomplete dropdown after closing a function call body or aggregation operator with a closing parenthesis. #19825
- [BUGFIX] Web: Fix HTTP/2 negotiation silently falling back to HTTP/1.1 under Go 1.27+ when TLS is enabled with `http2: true`. The server now correctly advertises `h2` via ALPN and multiplexes concurrent requests over a single connection. #19848
- [BUGFIX] mixin: Fix double-counting of failed samples in the `PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures` alert denominator. #19877
- [BUGFIX] promtool: Honor `--enable-feature` when evaluating rules in `test rules`. #20046
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Ensure UTF-8 works with the experimental OpenMetrics 2.0 #19902
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Reject sum-only classic histograms during NHCB conversion #19315

data.name: Release v2.23.0
data.body:
### Backend Changes

#### ⛔ Breaking Changes

* Fix(storage): remove unused clickhouse feature gates ([@albertteoh](https://github.com/albertteoh) in [#9988](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9988))
* Fix(storage): resolve auth extension references deterministically ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9772](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9772))
* Chore(ai-sidecar): remove the gemini reference sidecar ([@alishair7071](https://github.com/alishair7071) in [#9841](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9841))
* Feat(clickhouse): require an explicit table engine when creating the schema ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9813](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9813))

#### ✨ New Features

* Feat(mcp): accept a sql statement in the search_traces tool ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9925](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9925))
* Feat(query): add a sql query surface that compiles to rfc 0005 filters ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9922](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9922))
* Feat(query): serve storage search capabilities over api_v3 http ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9804](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9804))
* Feat(query): serve storage search capabilities over api_v3 grpc ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9803](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9803))
* Build(idl): bump jaeger-idl to v0.14.0 ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9802](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9802))
* Feat(clickhouse): route structured query filters to sql where (rfc 0005 m3) ([@om7057](https://github.com/om7057) in [#9701](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9701))

#### 🐞 Bug fixes, Minor Improvements

* Fix(mcp): start the investigation strategy with read_skill ([@lopster568](https://github.com/lopster568) in [#10038](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10038))
* Fix(otel-demo): add 30-day opensearch index retention ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9917](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9917))
* Fix(es): store non-finite doubles as otlp/json string tags ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9912](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9912))
* Fix(query): deduplicate shared span ids in linear time ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9764](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9764))
* Fix(query): recover from panics in query grpc and mcp handlers ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9766](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9766))
* Feat(query): forward captured identity headers onto the acp agent handshake ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#10007](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10007))
* Fix(mcp): guard trace walks against duplicate span ids ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9763](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9763))
* Fix(query): check filter nesting depth before decoding api_v3 parameters ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#10006](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10006))
* Feat(query): support prettyprint on the v3 http api ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#9990](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9990))
* Fix(jaegermcp): expose total_span_count in get_trace_topology ([@alliasgher](https://github.com/alliasgher) in [#8530](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/8530))
* Feat(storage): honor anchors and case folding in regex filter patterns ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9923](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9923))
* Fix(query): reject durations that overflow ([@sublimemonk](https://github.com/sublimemonk) in [#9877](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9877))
* Fix(query): render non-finite float attributes as strings ([@ayush00git](https://github.com/ayush00git) in [#9901](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9901))
* Feat(query): add ai.auth to gate the ai endpoints with an authenticator ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9908](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9908))
* Fix(clickhouse): bind gettraces time bounds at nanosecond precision ([@NUAAwqy](https://github.com/NUAAwqy) in [#9894](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9894))
* Fix(clickhouse): bound distributed trace searches ([@zarna1parekh](https://github.com/zarna1parekh) in [#9882](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9882))
* Fix(jaegerai): start a new text message after each tool call ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9879](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9879))
* Fix(jaegerai): keep whitespace-only streaming chunks ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9878](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9878))
* Fix(query): reject non-positive lookback, step and rateper in metrics api ([@sublimemonk](https://github.com/sublimemonk) in [#9863](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9863))
* Refactor(ai): remove legacy acp tool routing ([@alishair7071](https://github.com/alishair7071) in [#9855](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9855))
* Fix(tenancy): reject empty tenant values on grpc ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9768](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9768))
* Fix(query): drop resource spans emptied by dedup ([@jayhemnani9910](https://github.com/jayhemnani9910) in [#9836](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9836))
* Fix(query): reject non-positive lookback values ([@sloemo01](https://github.com/sloemo01) in [#9832](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9832))
* Fix(cassandra): stop duration search at depth ([@sublimemonk](https://github.com/sublimemonk) in [#9853](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9853))
* Feat(mcp): add streamable_http transport options to ai.mcp ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9857](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9857))
* Feat(memory): evaluate phrase and fulltext operators in memory store ([@rishabhkumar92](https://github.com/rishabhkumar92) in [#9791](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9791))
* Feat(mcp): add ai.mcp.disable_localhost_protection for proxied deployments ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9849](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9849))
* Fix(remotesampling): wait for serve goroutines in shutdown ([@stanleys12](https://github.com/stanleys12) in [#9824](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9824))
* Fix(mcptools): set error status on spans for failed tool calls ([@SoumyaRaikwar](https://github.com/SoumyaRaikwar) in [#9809](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9809))
* Fix(storage/es): accept non-string index settings in getjaegerindices ([@pujitha24](https://github.com/pujitha24) in [#9252](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9252))
* Fix(cache): check ttl in compareandswap ([@RudraDudhat2509](https://github.com/RudraDudhat2509) in [#9736](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9736))
* Fix(query): reject inverted/zero time range in apiv2 getdependencies ([@pranitaurlam](https://github.com/pranitaurlam) in [#9239](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9239))
* Fix(clickhouse): reject default_search_depth exceeding max_search_depth and negative dial_timeout ([@padmasri-web](https://github.com/padmasri-web) in [#9725](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9725))
* Fix(es): reject negative index retention ([@viiccwen](https://github.com/viiccwen) in [#9123](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9123))
* Feat(es): record bulk request size metrics for the elasticsearch writer ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9787](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9787))
* Fix(badger): remove stale operations entries on service expiry ([@bhavyamsharmaa](https://github.com/bhavyamsharmaa) in [#9021](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9021))
* Fix(storage): sanitize remote storage exports ([@viiccwen](https://github.com/viiccwen) in [#9062](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9062))
* Fix(examples): set max_span_age in opensearch demo ([@sahilnyk](https://github.com/sahilnyk) in [#9124](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9124))
* Fix(mcptools): always emit mcp.method.name attribute on mcp tracing spans ([@Aryanbhargava18](https://github.com/Aryanbhargava18) in [#9749](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9749))
* Fix(es): turn off the span search _id tie-breaker by default ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9783](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9783))
* Fix(docker): run images with a non-root primary group ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9771](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9771))
* Fix(query): treat non-string library attributes as conflicts instead of panicking ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9765](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9765))
* Fix(spm): escape service names in promql matchers ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9769](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9769))
* Fix(es-index-cleaner): escape index names in delete requests ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9770](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9770))
* Fix(deps): update apache thrift to v0.25.0 ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9756](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9756))
* Fix hardcoded metricstore es extended lookback ([@HESleagacy](https://github.com/HESleagacy) in [#9102](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9102))

#### 👷 CI Improvements

* Fix(demo): give otel demo checkout enough memory to serve orders ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#10005](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10005))
* Ci(publish): stop trusting fork ci summary artifacts ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9998](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9998))
* Fix(ci): let manual release runs build a given ref and flag commits past the tag ([@albertteoh](https://github.com/albertteoh) in [#9985](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9985))
* Fix(ci): give the execution-mode step a token so the trust checks can call the api ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#10013](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10013))
* Fix(ci): restore the clickhouse metrics snapshot filename ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9951](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9951))
* Chore(query): move the last v1 trace callers to the v3 api ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#10004](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10004))
* Fix(release): harden prepare.sh and start.sh against release-manager mistakes ([@albertteoh](https://github.com/albertteoh) in [#9986](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9986))
* Feat(ocb): wire build-ocb to the workspace overwrite pattern ([@iammdzaidalam](https://github.com/iammdzaidalam) in [#8871](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/8871))
* Ci: limit active prs per issue ([@Harizz076](https://github.com/Harizz076) in [#9800](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9800))
* Feat(clickhouse): test both supported clickhouse lts lines in ci ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9893](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9893))

#### ⚙️ Refactoring

* Refactor(query): split the gateway's streamingclient into aguirun and acpclient ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#10017](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10017))
* Chore(safeexpvar): remove the unused package ([@AnKiT-GaRG2](https://github.com/AnKiT-GaRG2) in [#9829](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9829))
* Refactor(query): move the ai configuration and routes into jaegerai ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9907](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9907))
* Refactor(clickhouse): name the search stages and share one rows loop ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9899](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9899))

#### 📖 Documentation

* Docs(remote-storage): document the grpc port as a trusted interface ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9872](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9872))
* Docs(security): refresh threat model ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9821](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9821))
* Docs(release): land due feature-gate transitions before preparing a release ([@albertteoh](https://github.com/albertteoh) in [#9984](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9984))
* [badger] document span kind index design in rfc 0020 ([@Audio431](https://github.com/Audio431) in [#8402](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/8402))
* Docs(rfc): name what the legacy filter rewrite carries for the flat backends ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9960](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9960))
* Docs(rfc): keep the flat backends on the legacy filter rewrite ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9959](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9959))
* Docs(mcp): document endpoint exposure and security setup ([@shantanu-1607](https://github.com/shantanu-1607) in [#9828](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9828))
* Docs(rfc): propose configurable clickhouse attribute hoisting ([@rishabhkumar92](https://github.com/rishabhkumar92) in [#9902](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9902))
* Chore(clickhouse): pin images to the 26.8 lts line and link the policy to the pins ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9892](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9892))
* Docs(ai): require goose v1.55.0 for trace propagation ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9867](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9867))
* Docs(rfc): define the text-search operators and how a new operator lands ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9758](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9758))

### 📊 UI Changes

#### ⛔ Breaking Changes

* Feat(trace): open the json views from the v3 trace api ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4678](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4678))
* Refactor(api): migrate downloads to jaegerclient ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4649](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4649))

#### ✨ New Features

* Feat(trace): load native otlp traces ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4605](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4605))

#### 🐞 Bug fixes, Minor Improvements

* Fix(trace): keep cached traces on refetch errors ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4692](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4692))
* Fix(assistant): keep lone underscores and asterisks in markdown ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#4623](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4623))
* Fix(ui): keep detected base on this origin ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#4679](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4679))
* Fix(api): read the nested v3 gateway error message ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4675](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4675))
* Fix(ui): add accessible aria-label to icon-only standalone links (#4596) ([@padmasri-web](https://github.com/padmasri-web) in [#4597](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4597))
* Fix(ui): adjust edge label coordinates for self-referencing nodes in dag view ([@harshitt13](https://github.com/harshitt13) in [#3987](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/3987))
* Fix(api): append the server message to http errors ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#4670](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4670))
* Fix(search): extract messages from error bodies ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4666](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4666))
* Fix(metrics): validate data and rethrow aborts ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#4665](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4665))
* Fix(timeline): use single shoulddisablecollapse implementation ([@om7057](https://github.com/om7057) in [#4594](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/pull/4594))

## Changelog since v1.37.2

### Changes by Kind

#### Ci
 - Fixed exclusive CPU cleanup when cgroups disappear during container cleanup. (#10468, @bitoku)

#### Dependency-Change
 - With `stream_websockets` and conmon-rs v1.2.0 or later, conmon-rs also serves port forwarding and its streaming sessions end after `stream_idle_timeout` of inactivity. Older conmon-rs versions disable `stream_websockets`, and pods started by them keep using the CRI-O streaming server. A conmon-rs server which does not exit on pod removal gets killed. A negative `stream_idle_timeout` fails the config validation. With conmon-rs, `log_to_journald` also logs containers to the journal, and exec syncs which conmon-rs could not start fail instead of returning exit code -2 or -3. (#10481, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)

#### Bug or Regression
 - Attaching to stdin once containers with conmon-rs no longer loses the output after the client closes its stdin. conmon-rs now gets the same environment as conmon (`monitor_env`) instead of the whole CRI-O environment, so variables set only on the CRI-O service (for example `OTEL_*` or proxy settings) no longer reach conmon-rs and the OCI runtime unless they are added to `monitor_env`. Attaching to a stdin once container through the conmon-rs streaming server now closes the container stdin when the client closes its stdin. (#10445, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)
 - Fix userns-mode when combined with a Kubelet supporting user namespaces. (#10429, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)
 - Fixed a possible crash and a panic of CRI-O with the pod runtime type (conmon-rs), and a leaked conmon-rs server after removing a pod with pod events enabled. (#10505, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)
 - When crio.service is restarted while containers are being created, an in-flight conmon process can still be killed and its crio-conmon-*.scope unit can still enter a failed state. That scope is now automatically garbage collected by systemd instead of persisting in `systemctl --failed` indefinitely. (#10451, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)

#### Uncategorized
 - Fixed CRI-O crash loops and stuck-Terminating pods caused by dead kata shims. (#10422, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)
 - Fixed a leak of the seccomp notifier file descriptor into the container monitor, 
  which left the kernel's seccomp notify listener attached with no reader after a CRI-O restart, 
  causing process creation inside seccomp-notifier-armed containers to block indefinitely. (#10462, @openshift-cherrypick-robot)

data.name: v1.33.8
data.body:
We are delighted to present version v1.33.8 of Contour, our layer 7 HTTP reverse proxy for Kubernetes clusters.

- [All Changes](#all-changes)
- [Installing/Upgrading](#installing-and-upgrading)
- [Compatible Kubernetes Versions](#compatible-kubernetes-versions)

# All Changes

## Security fix for [GHSA-899w-6852-7fr3](https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/security/advisories/GHSA-899w-6852-7fr3)

Crash loop when an Ingress has a resource backend.

## Security fix for [GHSA-9x3c-68m7-f3x4](https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/security/advisories/GHSA-9x3c-68m7-f3x4)

HTTPProxy JWKS settings can be replaced by another HTTPProxy that uses the same JWKS host.

## Security fix for [GHSA-g6qh-g3pq-5cpm](https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/security/advisories/GHSA-g6qh-g3pq-5cpm)

Included HTTPProxy can receive requests outside its prefix by using regex.

## Other Changes

- Updates Envoy to v1.38.9. See the [Envoy release notes](https://www.envoyproxy.io/docs/envoy/v1.38.9/version_history/v1.38/v1.38.9) for more information about the content of the release.
- Bumps Go to 1.26.10.
- Updated dependencies to fix CVEs.

# Installing and Upgrading

For a fresh install of Contour, consult the [getting started documentation](https://projectcontour.io/getting-started/).

To upgrade an existing Contour installation, please consult the [upgrade documentation](https://projectcontour.io/resources/upgrading/).

# Compatible Kubernetes Versions

Contour v1.33.8 is tested against Kubernetes 1.35 through 1.37.

# Are you a Contour user? We would love to know!
If you're using Contour and want to add your organization to our adopters list, please visit this [page](https://projectcontour.io/resources/adopters/). If you prefer to keep your organization name anonymous but still give us feedback into your usage and scenarios for Contour, please post on this [GitHub thread](https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/issues/1269).

<!-- v1.37.2+k3s1 -->

This release updates Kubernetes to v1.37.2, and fixes a number of issues.

For more details on what's new, see the [Kubernetes release notes](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.37.md#changelog-since-v1371).

## Changes since v1.37.1+k3s1:

* Add gateway-api-crd to help [(#14727)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14727)
* Run snapshotrestore test entries in parallel [(#14733)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14733)
* Deps: bump containerd to v2.3.6 [(#14744)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14744)
* Bump Traefik to v3.7.14 and gateway-api to 1.6.2 [(#14757)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14757)
* Bump gateway-api to 1.6.3 [(#14769)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14769)
* Bump K3s-root version to v0.15.3 [(#14782)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14782)
* Bump flannel to v0.28.10 [(#14796)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14796)
* Bump containerd to v2.3.7 [(#14805)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14805)
* Update kube-roter to v2.11.1 [(#14762)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14762)
* Remove unused replace directives [(#14821)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14821)
* Bump Klipper Helm and Helm Controller version [(#14814)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14814)
* Backports for 2026-10 [(#14825)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14825)
  * Prevent systemd restart loop when no default route is present by waiting 60 seconds for default route to appear #14527
  * Exclude kms-providers from apiserver readiness check #14635
  * Clarify etcd local vs S3 snapshot retention flag help #14716
  * Update ServiceLB status when node addresses change #14550
  * Omit default SA key flags when service-account-signing-endpoint is set #14719
  * Fix local-path PV deletion with SELinux enforcing #14740
  * Feature/14562 etcd snapshot restrictions #14678
  * Report image list read errors when pre-pulling images #14732
  * Migrate CI from docker to GHCR #14603
  * Fix etcd member removal when etcd is disabled on an existing server #14801
  * Docker tests: add gateway-api test #14802
  * Fix goroutine leak in the proxy #14811
  * Make etcdsnapshot restrictions integration test respect the test lock #14820
* Bump rancher/mirrored-library-traefik image version [(#14833)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14833)
* Bump Klipper Helm and Helm Controller version [(#14874)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14874)
* Pin runners to ubuntu-24.04 [(#14918)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14918)
* Bump k3s-io/kubernetes and Go references [(#14925)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14925)
* Bump x/net and pass `golang.org/x/` replacements through when building bundled binaries [(#14935)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14935)
